name: The Legend of the White Egg

meals.note: Ursula sits twice. Order Coffee-Berry Paste, Pumpkin Soup, then Sand Boar and Beans (no Perfect dish for the third).
Gaitz with Goliath or other army members: he needs Support 3 by Ch 12.

missables.text: Save on 9/16, then clear Bertrand's Paralogue on 9/17, its only day: Gaitz needs it
missables.lose: Gaitz on this path, plus the Extra Large Bullion, 20,000G and 150 Renown

missables.text: Clear Talimun's Paralogue on 9/18 or 9/19 (backup window 10/1 to 10/10)
missables.lose: Ursula, if the 10/1 to 10/10 backup window also passes

missables.text: Clear Theodora's Paralogue by 9/15: its [[item:Pilum]] is Esmeralda's
Starting Leda's Paralogue skips the calendar to 9/8: finish other plans for 9/2 to 9/8 first
missables.lose: the days between the start and 9/8

missables.text: Take My Late Sister's Accessory if it shows up: Creek and Nathan join in Part II only with it
missables.lose: Creek in Part II Ch 2 and Nathan in Ch 3
detail: It appears at random, but it's reported on Dietrich's Ch 9.

note.text: No Advanced exams until Renown 8 (end of Ch 9 at best): push the first four to Lv 35 now
detail: Lv 35: Yang Jie, Fabio, Dietrich, Esmeralda. Ranks: Mikaela Gauntlet B, Axe B, Sword B; Kiroc Bow B.
Renown 8 before 9/19? Exam whoever is ready, in the Ledger's Advanced order.
Finishing blows to Yang Jie, Fabio, Esmeralda, then Mikaela, Kiroc, Olympia. Dietrich ends Part I near Lv 38.

buy.text: Pick up Da Mina weapons, and keep 2 spare for Its Name Is Da Mina (Ch 10)
Replace Javelins and Hand Axes with [[item:Short Spear]]s and [[item:Short Axe]]s

note.text: Farm Magic Echo Shards: finish the 10 Combat Art upgrades by Ch 11
detail: Spend every shard before Part II: each Part II chapter sets them to 100 instead of adding.

recruits.action: Answer Yes three times right after Talimun's Paralogue, at Support 3 and Renown 7
detail: Still short of Renown 7 on 9/19? Recruit her in Ch 10, in Talimun's backup window.

recruits.action: Recruit after Leda's Paralogue (9/8) at Support 3 and Renown 8: supports Dietrich, Jester, Olympia
recruits.when: End of Ch 9 at best, else Ch 10
detail: Filler, bench only.

prep.text: Fianna: recruit her now if Renown 7 came after Ch 8 (her row is in Ch 8)

route.note: If Renown 7 came too late in Ch 8: [[place:Stoppered Shrine]]
Only if Renown 8 lands before 9/19: [[place:Aditi's Cave]]

sub.note: Violet Brooch from the bandits at [[place:Axion Gorge]] (Saveilon)
[[place:Faun's Forest]], for the Hunter in Lowtown
Rahlan from Port of Pandora, for the Worshipper at Jurah's Temple
Only if the pearl chain started

paralogue.note: Leda's, the easiest: its [[item:Silver Shield]] is Goliath's shield
detail: Break obstacles, kill everything, watch for poison.
Pack Esmeralda an [[item:Antitoxin]] (Valhalla Mine chest).

paralogue.note: Theodora's, from Bonaventure at Temple Row: fogged, so equip Credna's Lv 1 Blessing (+5 vision)
detail: Stand on the three mechanisms (southeast, southwest, northwest); keep fragile units back.
Swap Kiroc and Fabio for Io and Jester to reach the switches; keep Yang Jie behind Esmeralda.

paralogue.note: Bertrand's, from Gabriel at Arena Square: required for Gaitz
detail: The shortest Paralogue window in the game.
Kill 4 Giants before the rival group does.
Bait your target Giant and ignore the yellow units around it.

paralogue.note: Talimun's, from Talimun near the Port: its [[item:Cleansing Blade]] is Jester's
detail: Keep one unit back to catch the thief running for the top exit: Io or Jester in the flex slot.

explore.text: Clear the eight quests due 9/1 first, then level up: the Paralogues start 9/2
[[place:Southern Passage]] (story dungeon): Salamander for Yang Jie, [[item:Archive Z]] for Dante
detail: An Event Clash waits at the end.
Hold Archive Z until Dante joins in Ch 10, then read it at once.

explore.text: Take 2 or 3 core units plus the late joiners who need weapon ranks
detail: Simon fights with gauntlets (Warrior), Olympia with Black Magic (Ovate).
Jester uses his bow (Rogue, Ranger), Goliath his axes (Dreadnought).
Levels don't matter much: Part II Army Training lifts everyone to Lv 34+. Ranks don't come with it.

tips.text: Move north as a group; spend an action to partly clear the sandstorm

exitExtra.text: Have Yang Jie, Fabio, Dietrich and Esmeralda near Lv 35 and their Advanced ranks for Ch 10
detail: Mikaela and Kiroc around Lv 30; Olympia and Goliath past Lv 20.
